sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Copy of Portal Polaris Header">813ca562935276100fa17bfdfaba1054</child><cloned>2026-01-10 15:39:59</cloned><last_validated>2026-01-10 15:39:59</last_validated><parent display_value="Portal Polaris Header">3552f974845a1110f87767389929c604</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>standard</category><client_script><![CDATA[function pspHeaderController($rootScope, $scope, $window, spUtil, $location, $uibModal, cabrillo, $timeout, i18n, spContextManager,spAriaUtil) {
    var c = this;
	var userOptionsMessage=i18n.getMessage('User options: {userName}');
	c.userLabel = userOptionsMessage.replace('{userName}',$scope.user.name);
    $scope.avatarProfile = {
		userID: $scope.user.sys_id,
		name: $scope.user.name,
		initials: $window.NOW.user_initials
	  };
	  if ($window.NOW.user_avatar) {
		$scope.avatarProfile.userImage = $window.NOW.user_avatar;
	  }
    // Events fired from/to $rootScope for responsive mobile view.
    c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU = 'showMobileMegaMenu';
    c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP = 'showMobileMenuOnDesktop';
    c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY = 'toggleMobileMenuVisibility';

    $scope.showSearchBar = true;
    $scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
    $scope.popupType = c.data.isMobile ? 'collapse' : 'dropdown';
    $scope.expanded = false;
    $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
	var flag = 0;
    // $scope.loadingIndicator = $rootScope.loadingIndicator;

    /* Below 2 scope variables (showMobileMenuOnDesktop, showMobileMegaMenu) have counterparts in EC Navigation widget also.
     So whenever we set these variables, make sure to emit an event on rootScope to update them in the former widget as well. */

    // Determines whether to show mobile view on desktop due to oveflow of items in sub navigation bar of header.
    $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = false;
    // Used to hide global navigation tools on mobile while showing mega menu topics in right panel.
    $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;

    c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH = 767;
    $scope.mobileDevice = c.data.isMobile || ($window.innerWidth <= c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH);

    if (cabrillo.isNative())
        $scope.isViewNative = true;

    $scope.isCategorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu = false;
    $rootScope.$on('categorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu', function(event, isCategorySelected) {
        $scope.isCategorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu = isCategorySelected;
    });
    $scope.newPageId = c.data.initialPageId;
    $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = false;
    
    c.getContainer = function(){
		  return $("." + "instance" + "-" + c.data.instanceId);
	  };

    $scope.showSearchBarMobile = function(event) {
		if (event.keyCode === 13 || event.keyCode === 32) {
			event.preventDefault();
		}
      $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = true;
      $timeout(function() {
        $scope.focusOnSearchBar();
      });
    };

   	$scope.hideSearchBarMobile = function() {
        $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = false;
		$timeout(function(){
			 $scope.$apply();
		},10);    
    };


    document.addEventListener('focus', (event) => {
	var  currentlyFocusedElement = event.target;
	if(flag ==1)
	{
		if(currentlyFocusedElement.name!= 'search' &&  currentlyFocusedElement!=c.getContainer().find('input[name="q"]')[0] && currentlyFocusedElement!=c.getContainer().find('sn-search-combobox')[0]){
			var typeaheadSearchDiv = c.getContainer().find('#searchBox');
			typeaheadSearchDiv.removeClass("show-search").addClass('hide-search');
			$timeout(function() {
				// visibility should be hidden after the collapsing animation, hence the timeout
				typeaheadSearchDiv.addClass('visibility-collapse');
				c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon').removeClass('hidden');
			}, 500);
			if($scope.mobileDevice)
				$scope.hideSearchBarMobile();
			flag =0;
		}
	}
    }, true);

    $scope.focusOnSearchBar = function() {
		flag=1;
      // focus on the search widget input box, and add a blur event
      if (c.data.aisEnabled) {
        var searchBox = c.getContainer().find('sn-search-combobox')[0];
		if ($scope.mobileDevice)
        searchBox.addEventListener('blur', $scope.onSearchBoxBlur);
        $timeout(function() {
          searchBox.shadowRoot.childNodes[0].shadowRoot.childNodes[0].querySelector('input').focus();
        }, 500);
      } else {
        var searchBox = c.getContainer().find('input[name="q"]')[0];
		searchBox.addEventListener('keydown',(event)=>$scope.onSearchBoxTab(event));
        searchBox.focus();
      }
    };
	
		$scope.onSearchBoxTab = function(event){
			$timeout(function() {
				if(event.keyCode==9){
            var searchIcon =  c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon');
						searchIcon.focus();
				}        
        }, 525);
		
		};

    $scope.showAndExpandSearch = function(event) {
      // show typeahead search widget and hide search icon on Desktop view
			spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(i18n.getMessage("button expanded"));
      c.getContainer().find('#searchBox').removeClass('hide-search').addClass('show-search').removeClass('visibility-collapse');
	    c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon').addClass('hidden');
      $scope.focusOnSearchBar();
    };

    $scope.onSearchBoxBlur = function(event) {
     	$scope.hideSearchBarMobile();
    };

    $scope.getUrlParameters = function(parameter, decode, staticURL) {
      var url = staticURL ? staticURL : $location.url();
      var currLocation = (url.length) ? url : window.location.search;
      if (!currLocation || !currLocation.split("?") || currLocation.split("?").length < 2)
        return '';
      var paramArr = currLocation.split("?")[1].split("&");
      var numOfParams = paramArr.length;
      for (var i = 0; i < numOfParams; i++) {
        param = paramArr[i].split("=");
        if (param[0] === parameter)
          return (decode) ? decodeURIComponent(param[1]) : param[1];
      }
      return '';
    };

    $scope.$on("$sp.service_catalog.cart.count", function($evt, count) {
        $scope.cartItemCount = count;
    });

    $scope.$on("$locationChangeSuccess", function(event, data) {
      $scope.newPageId = $scope.getUrlParameters("id", true, data);
        if (c.data.isMobile) {
            if ($('div#popup_todos_mobile').is(":visible"))
                $('li > a#todos_popup').click();
            else if ($('div#popup_cases_mobile').is(":visible"))
                $('li > a#cases_popup').click();
        } else {
            $('li.open > a#cases_popup').click();
            $('li.open > a#todos_popup').click();
        }

      // hide modal-div on location change
      if($scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded){
        $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
        $scope.expanded = false;
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
        $rootScope.$emit(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
      }
    });

    $scope.openLogin = function() {
        $scope.modalInstance = $uibModal.open({
            templateUrl: 'spPolarisModalLogin',
            scope: $scope
        });

        var pageRoot = angular.element('.sp-page-root');
        $scope.modalInstance.rendered.then(function() {
            var $uibModalStack = $injector.get('$uibModalStack');
            var modalObj = $uibModalStack.getTop();
            var modal = modalObj.value.modalDomEl;

            modal.attr('aria-label', modal.find('.panel-title').html());
            modal.attr('aria-modal', 'true');
            pageRoot.attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
        });

        $scope.modalInstance.closed.then(function() {
            pageRoot.attr('aria-hidden', 'false');
        });
    };

    $rootScope.$on("update.searchpage", function(e, searchPage) {
        $scope.searchPage = searchPage;
    });

    $rootScope.$on('sp.avatar_changed', function() {
        $scope.userID = '';
        $timeout(function() {
            $scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
        });
    });

    $rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP, function(event, showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
        if (!showMobileMenuOnDesktop && $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
            $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
        }
        $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = showMobileMenuOnDesktop;
    });

    $rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, function(event, showMobileMegaMenu) {
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = showMobileMegaMenu;
    });

    $scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility = function(event) {
        if (event) {
            event.stopPropagation();
        }
        $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = !$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded;
        $scope.expanded = false;
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
        $rootScope.$emit(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
    };

    $rootScope.$on(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY, function() {
        $scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility();
    });

    $scope.isHomepage = function() {
        if (!$scope.page.id)
            return true;

        if ($scope.page.id == $scope.portal.homepage_dv)
            return true;

        return false;
    };

}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$sp-space--xxs: 2px !default;

$sp-space--sm: 8px !default;
$sp-space--md: 12px !default;
$sp-space--lg: 16px !default;
$sp-space--xl: 24px !default;
$sp-space--3xl: 40px !default;
$background-primary : $body-bg !default;
$font-size-md: 16px !default;
$font-size-large: 20px !default;
$font-size-xl: 24px !default;
$brand-primary-darker: darken($brand-primary,16) !default;

#searchBox .btn{
  padding : 0px $sp-space--lg;
}

.dropdown-menu.empty-dropdown.ng-scope,.dropdown-menu.cart-dropdown.custom-drop-down,.dropdown-menu.wishlist-menu.custom-drop-down {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  padding-bottom: 0 !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}


.navbar-inverse {
  margin-bottom: 0px;
  border-radius: 0px; 
  background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
  .navbar-header {
    &amp;.nav-container {
      width: 100%;

      .sub-navbar-overflow-entry-button {
        position: relative;
        float: right;
        margin: $sp-space--md $sp-space--lg $sp-space--md 0;
        padding: $sp-space--sm $sp-space--sm;
        background-color: transparent;
        background-image: none;
        border: .1rem solid transparent;
        border-radius: $border-radius-base;
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .25);

       .label {
         float: right;
         margin-right: -$sp-space--xs;
         margin-top: -$sp-space--sm;
         padding: $sp-space--xxs $sp-space--xs;
       }

       .label-as-badge {
          font-size: $font-size-xs;
          position: relative;
          top: -$sp-space--xxs;
          left: $sp-space--xxs;
          padding: $sp-space--xxs $sp-space--xs;
          margin-left: 0;
          background-color: $btn-danger-bg;
          color: $background-primary;
        }

        .icon-bar {
          display: block;
          width: 2.2rem;
          height: .2rem;
          border-radius: $border-radius-small;
          background-color: $background-primary;
        }
        .icon-bar + .icon-bar {
          margin-top: $sp-space--xs;
        }
      }
    }

    .mobile-view-on-desktop {
    	position: absolute;
      z-index: 999;
      /* 60px is height of the header strip */
      top: 60px;
      right: 0;
      min-height: 500px;
      max-width: 400px;
      background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 5px $navbar-inverse-link-color;
      color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;

      .mobile-view-navbar {
         list-style: none;
         padding: 0 $sp-space--sm;
         margin: 0;
         display: flex;
         flex-direction: column;
         border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 45%);

         .main-header-items {
           list-style: none;
           padding: $sp-space--md 0 0 $sp-space--lg;
           margin: 0;
           display: flex;
           flex-direction: column;

           &amp; &gt; li {
             &amp;:not(:last-child) {
               padding-top: $sp-space--lg;
             }
             // Cart, tours, and Wishlist (Mobile View)
             .nav.navbar-nav {
               display: flex;
               flex-direction: column;

               li {
                 padding-top: $sp-space--lg;
               }
             }
           }
         }

         .mobile-mega-menu-entry {
           margin: 0 -$sp-space--sm;
           padding: $sp-space--xl $sp-space--lg;
           background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
           
           .dropdown-menu {
           	background-color: transparent;
           }
         }
         .separator {
           margin: 20px -$sp-space--sm;
           border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 30%);
         }

         li &gt; a {
           color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;
           padding: 0;

           &amp;:hover, &amp;:focus {
             color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color !important;
             background-color: transparent;
           }
           &amp;:focus {
             box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
             padding: $sp-space--xs;
             border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
             border-radius: $border-radius-base;
           }
         }
        .header-menu-item &gt; a{
        	padding: $sp-space--md $sp-space--sm;
        }
       }

      .impersonate-and-logout {
          div &gt; ul &gt; li:first-child {
            height: 0;

            ul.dropdown-menu {
              width: 400px;
              display: block;
              z-index: inherit;
              background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
              box-shadow: none;
              border-radius: 0;
              padding-left: $sp-space--xxs;
              padding-bottom: $sp-space--lg;

              li &gt; a {
                line-height: 2;

                &amp;:hover, &amp;:focus {
                  color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color !important;
                  background-color: transparent;
                }
                &amp;:focus {
                  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
                  padding: $sp-space--xs;
                  margin-left: $sp-space--lg;
                  border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
                  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
                  width: fit-content;
                }
              }
              li:first-child {
                display: none;
              }
           }
         }
       }
     }

    .navbar-brand {
      margin: 0;
      height: 60px;
      padding: $sp-logo-margin-y 0px $sp-space--sm $sp-space--lg;
      img, span {
        margin: 0;
        display: block;
        max-height: $sp-logo-max-height;
        max-width: $sp-logo-max-width;
        position: relative;
        top: 50%;
        -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%);
        -ms-transform: translateY(-50%);
        transform: translateY(-50%);
	padding-right: $sp-space--sm;
      }
    }

    .navbar-right .dropdown-menu &gt; li &gt; a {
      &amp;:hover, &amp;:focus {
        background-color: darken($navbar-inverse-bg, 8%);
      }

      &amp;:focus {
        border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
        border-radius: $border-radius-base;
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
      }
    }
  }
  .dropdown-menu &gt; li &gt; a {
    color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;
  }
  .dropdown-toggle:focus {
  	outline: thin dotted;
    outline: 5px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
  }
  .sub-navbar {
    background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
    border: none;
    width: 100%;
   
    #cart-dropdown, #wishlist-menu {
      display: none;
      ~ * {
        display: none !important;
      }
    }
    .navbar-nav &gt; li &gt; a[href="?id=sc_cart"], .navbar-nav &gt; li &gt; a[href="?id=sc_wishlist"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .gtd-dropdown-container {
      display: none;
    }
    .open &gt; a, .open &gt; a:focus {
      background-color: darken($sp-navbar-divider-color, 8%);
    }
    #cart-dropdown {
      display: none;
      :after {
        content: "\f0d7";
        vertical-align: baseline;
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        border: none;
        margin-left: sp-space--xs !important;
        display: inline-block;
        font: normal normal normal $font-size-small/1 FontAwesome;
        font-size: inherit;
        text-rendering: auto;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      }
    }
   
    .dropdown-menu {
      background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
      &gt; li &gt; a:hover, &gt; li &gt; a:focus {
        background-color: darken($sp-navbar-divider-color, 8%);
	box-shadow:unset;
      }
    }
  }
  .dropdown-menu {
    background-color: rgba($navbar-inverse-bg, 0.97);
    border: none;
    &amp;.case-menu {
      right: 0;
      left: auto;
      padding: 0;
      width: 450px;
      background: $background-primary;
      overflow-y: hidden;
    }
  }
  &gt; .open &gt; a:hover, &gt; .open &gt; a:focus  {
    background-color: darken($navbar-invese-bg, 8%);
  }
  .fa-caret-down {
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin-top: $sp-space--xxs;
  }
  .caret:before {
    content: "\f0d7";
  }
  .caret {
    vertical-align: baseline;
    width: auto;

          if (qsConfigJson.headerSearch.search_placeholder_text)
              typeAheadOptions.title = gs.getMessage(qsConfigJson.headerSearch.search_placeholder_text);
      }
      data.typeAheadSearch = $sp.getWidget('typeahead-search', typeAheadOptions);
	  }
	  if(qsConfigJson.widget){
		data.embeddedWidget = $sp.getWidget(qsConfigJson.widget.widget_id, qsConfigJson.widget.instance_options || {});
	  }
	  data.showTypeAheadSearch = (data.typeAheadSearch && data.typeAheadSearch.sys_id ? true : false) && qsConfigJson.headerSearch && qsConfigJson.headerSearch.display_search === true;
	

    var showSubHeaderString = qsConfigJson.showSubHeader;
    if (!gs.nil(showSubHeaderString))
        switch (showSubHeaderString.toUpperCase()) {
            case "ON_LOG_IN":
                data.showSubHeader = gs.isLoggedIn();
                break;
            case "NEVER":
                data.showSubHeader = false;
                break;
            case "ALWAYS":
            default:
                data.showSubHeader = true;
                break;
        }

    data.sub = {};
    data.top = {};

    var menu = $sp.getValue("sp_rectangle_menu");

    if (!gs.nil(menu)) {

        data.sub.menu = $sp.getWidgetFromInstance(menu);

                var item = subMenuDataItems[i];

        }

    data.showMoreItems = (moreItems && moreItems.label && data.moreItems && configOptions.enable_more_items) ? (data.moreItems.length > 0 && configOptions.enable_more_items.value) : false;

	//Clean up items that don't belong
    subMenu.data.cartWidget = {};

    data.top.menu.data.showTours = true;

    data.top.menu.data.menuType = 'TOP';

    if(data.top.menu.sys_id === '756957db43f5ed1011a4ebdffab8f243'){
			if (data.top.menu && data.top.menu.data && data.top.menu.data.menu && data.top.menu.data.menu.items){

		data.initialPageId = '';
})();

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_theme"><sp_theme action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css_variables> //=catalog
      $border-bg-transparent :transparent
      $align-left : left;
      $font-weight-base : 400;
      $font-weight-md : ceil(($font-weight-base * 1.25));//500
      $font-weight-lg : ceil(($font-weight-base * 1.5));//600
      $font-weight-xl : ceil(($font-weight-base * 1.75));//700
      $border-style-solid : solid;
      $box-size-border: border-box;
      $border-width-xs : 1px;
      $border-width-small : 2px;
      $border-rad-md : 6px;

      //=walkup
      $width-full : 100%;
      $padding-base : 0;
      $padding-left-base : 0;
      $margin-min : 0;
      $margin-top-base : 0;
      $margin-bottom-base : 0;

      //=New Variables
      //== Alignment
      $align-center :           center;
      $align-left :             left;

      //== Display
      $display-d1 :             flex;

      //==Text color
      $text-primary:                          #10171A; //$text-color --now-color_text--primary
      $text-secondary:                        #29353B; //--now-color_text--secondary
      $text-tertiary:                         #4F5C62; //$text-muted --now-color_text--tertiary
      $text-white:                            #ffffff; //--now-color--neutral-0

      //==Backgrounds
      $background-primary:                    #ffffff; //--now-color_background--primary
      $background-secondary:                  #f5f6f7; //--now-color_background--secondary
      $background-tertiary:                   #E2E5E7; //--now-color_background--tertiary

      //==borders
      $border-primary:                        #3D4A50; //--now-color_border--primary
      $border-secondary:                      #616D74; //--now-color_border--secondary
      $border-tertiary:                       #859095; //--now-color_border--tertiary
      $hr-border:                             #CFD5D7 !default; //--now-color_divider--tertiary
      $border-width-xs :                      1px;
      $border-width-small :                   2px;
      $border-style-solid :                   solid;
      $border-bg-transparent :                transparent;

      //==colors for selected
      $select-primary: 	                    #2D7524; //--now-color_selection--primary-2
      $select-primary-lighter: 	            #E0EADE; //--now-color_selection--primary-0
      $select-primary-darker: 	                #173B12; //--now-color_selection--primary-4

      //==Primary color
      $brand-primary-darkest:                 #002D39; //--now-color--primary-3
      $brand-primary-darker:                  #00566E; //--now-color--primary-2
      $brand-primary-lighter:                 #5EAFC5; //--now-color--interactive-1
      $brand-primary-lightest:                #BDDEE7; //--now-color--primary-0
      $brand-primary-opacity:				   #E5F2F6; //--now-color--primary-0 (with opacity 0.5)

      //==Brand Darker colors
      $brand-danger-darker:                   #B31B2C!default; //--now-color_alert--critical-3
      $brand-warning-darker:                  #8A7500!default; //--now-color_alert--warning-3
      $brand-moderate-darker:                 #6245CC!default; //--now-color_alert--moderate-3
      $brand-low-darker:                      #585961!default; //--now-color_alert--low-3
      $brand-success-darker:                  #306700!default; //--now-color_alert--positive-3
      $brand-info-darker:                     #005F9D!default; //--now-color_alert--info-3

      $sp-space--xxs:                         2px;
      $sp-space--xs:     	                    4px;
      $sp-space--sm:     	                    8px;
      $sp-space--md:    	                    12px;
      $sp-space--lg:     	                    16px;
      $sp-space--xl:		                    24px;
      $sp-space--xxl: 	                    32px;
      $sp-space--3xl: 	                    40px;

      $sp-panel-box-shadow:                   0 4px 8px 0 rgba(23,40,52,0.08);

      //==Subnav background-color
      $sp-nav-subnav:                         $sp-navbar-divider-color;

      //==End new variables ----/


      // Define NavBar
      $sp-navbar-height: 		                60px;
      $sp-navbar-divider-color:               $background-primary !default; //--now-color_chrome--divider-10
      $sp-navbar-inverse-bg:                  $navbar-inverse-bg !default;
      $navbar-inverse-bg:                     $background-primary !default; //--now-color_chrome--brand-10
      $navbar-inverse-link-color:             $text-primary !default; //--now-color--neutral-2
      $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color:       $text-primary !default; //--now-color--neutral-0
      $sp-logo-margin-x: 		                6px !default;
      $sp-logo-margin-y:		                6px !default;
      $sp-tagline-color:		                $text-color !default;

      // Define Body
      $body-bg:								              $background-secondary!default;
      $sp-body-bg:			                    $background-secondary;
      $table-hover:                         #e6f2ee; //--now-color_surface--brand-1

      $text-color:							            $text-primary!default;
      $text-muted:							            $text-tertiary!default;

      //## Gray and brand colors for use across Bootstrap.
      $gray-base:                             #000000; //--now-color--neutral-21
      $gray-darker:                           #10171A; //--now-color--neutral-18
      $gray-dark:                             #1D272B; //--now-color--neutral-16
      $gray:                                  #3D4A50; //--now-color--neutral-11
      $gray-light:                            #616D74; //--now-color--neutral-9
      $gray-lighter:                          #F5F6F7; //--now-color--neutral-1

      $brand-primary:                         #0080A3!default; //--now-color--primary-1
      $brand-danger:                          #E52239!default; //--now-color_alert--critical-2
      $brand-warning:                         #B29800!default; //--now-color_alert--warning-2
      $brand-moderate:                        #7B56FF!default; //--now-color_alert--moderate-2 NEW
      $brand-low:                            	#757681!default; //--now-color_alert--low-2 NEW
      $brand-success:                         #3E8600!default; //--now-color_alert--positive-2
      $brand-info:                            #007AC9!default; //--now-color_alert--info-2

      $primary:                               $brand-primary;
      $warning:                               $brand-warning;
      $success:                               $brand-success;
      $info:                                  $brand-info;
      $danger:                                $brand-danger;
      $error:                                 $danger;

      $color-darkest:                         #10171A; //--now-color--neutral-18
      $color-darker: 	                        #37444A; //--now-color--neutral-12
      $color-dark:                            #4F5C62; //--now-color--neutral-10
      $color-disabled:                        #97A2A6; //--now-color--neutral-6
      $color-light:                           #E2E5E7; //--now-color--neutral-4
      $color-lighter:                         #F5F6F7; //--now-color--neutral-2
      $color-lightest:                        #ffffff; //--now-color--neutral-0
      $color-accent:                          #2D7524; //--now-color_selection--primary-2
      $color-accent-light:                    #86B081; //--now-color_selection--primary-1
      $color-accent-lightest:                 #E0EADE; //--now-color_selection--primary-0

      $border:                                $border-tertiary;
      $panel-primary:                         $border;

      $overdue:                               $brand-danger;
      $due-today:                             $brand-warning;
      $due-later:                             $brand-success;
      $complete:                              $brand-low;
      $in-progress:                           $brand-success;

      $color-blue-lightest:                   #C4DBFE; //--now-color_grouped--blue-0
      $color-blue-light:                      #89B7FD; //--now-color_grouped--blue-1
      $color-blue-dark:                       #0F55C1; //--now-color_grouped--blue-4
      $color-grey:                            #B8BCBC; //--now-color_grouped--gray-1
      $color-green-dark:                      #004B2D; //--now-color_grouped--green-5

      $progress-bar:                          $brand-primary;

      //define service portal preview outline highlighting
      $preview-outline:                       #1A4E70; //--now-color_alert--info-4
      $preview-outline-text-color:            #ffffff; //--now-color--neutral-0



      ////Bootstrap variable

      //** Global textual link color.
      $link-color:                            #1955BE; //--now-color--link-2
      $link-hover-color:                      #113A82; //--now-color--link-3

      //== Typography
      $font-family-sans-serif:                "Lato", sans-serif;

      $font-size-base:                        16px;
      $font-size-3xl:                         ceil(($font-size-base * 2.25)); // 36px New
      $font-size-xxl:                         ceil(($font-size-base * 1.875)); // 30px  New
      $font-size-xl:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 1.5)); // 24px New
      $font-size-large:                       ceil(($font-size-base * 1.25)); // 20px
      $font-size-md:                          $font-size-base;  // 16px New
      $font-size-small:                       ceil(($font-size-base * 0.875)); // 14px
      $font-size-xs:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 0.75)); // 12px New

      $font-size-h1:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 2)); // 32px
      $font-size-h2:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 1.5)); // 24px
      $font-size-h3:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 1.25)); // 20px
      $font-size-h4:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 1.125)); // 18px
      $font-size-h5:                          $font-size-base;
      $font-size-h6:                          ceil(($font-size-base * 0.875)); // 14px

      $line-height-base:                      1.4;

      $headings-font-family:                  'Lato', sans-serif;
      $headings-font-weight:                  600;
      $font-weight-base : 400;
      $headings-line-height:                  1.1;

      //== Components
      //
      $padding-base-vertical:                 6px;
      $padding-base-horizontal:               $sp-space--lg;

      $padding-large-vertical:                $sp-space--sm;
      $padding-large-horizontal:              $sp-space--xl;

      $padding-small-vertical:                $sp-space--xs;
      $padding-small-horizontal:              $sp-space--md;

      $padding-xs-vertical:                   $sp-space--xs;
      $padding-xs-horizontal:                 $sp-space--sm;

      $border-radius-base:                    4px;
      $border-radius-large:                   8px;
      $border-radius-small:                   2px;

      //== Global color for active items (e.g., navs or dropdowns).
      $component-active-color:                $text-white;
      $component-active-bg:                   $select-primary;


      //== Tables
      //
      $table-cell-padding:                    $sp-space--sm;
      $table-condensed-cell-padding:          $sp-space--xs;

      $table-bg:                              transparent;
      $table-bg-accent:                       $background-secondary;
      $table-bg-hover:                        $background-tertiary;
      $table-border-color:                    $hr-border;

      //== Buttons
      //
      $btn-font-weight:                       600;

      $btn-default-color:                     $brand-primary;
      $btn-default-bg:                        $text-white;
      $btn-default-border:                    $border-tertiary;

      $btn-primary-color:                     $text-white;
      $btn-primary-bg:                        $brand-primary;
      $btn-primary-border:                    $brand-primary;

      $btn-success-color:                     $text-white;
      $btn-success-bg:                        $brand-success;
      $btn-success-border:                    $brand-success;

      $btn-info-color:                        $text-primary;
      $btn-info-bg:                           #8CCEF9; //--now-color_alert--info-1
      $btn-info-border:                       $btn-info-bg;

      $btn-warning-color:                     $text-primary;
      $btn-warning-bg:                        #F6ED6C; //--now-color_alert--warning-1
      $btn-warning-border:                    $btn-warning-bg;

      $btn-danger-color:                      $text-white;
      $btn-danger-bg:                         $brand-danger-darker;
      $btn-danger-border:                     $brand-danger-darker;

      $btn-link-disabled-color:               $text-muted;

      // Allows for customizing button radius independently from global border radius
      $btn-border-radius-base:                $border-radius-base;
      $btn-border-radius-large:               $border-radius-base;
      $btn-border-radius-small:               $border-radius-base;


      //== Forms
      //
      $input-bg:                              $background-primary;
      $input-bg-disabled:                     $background-secondary;
      $input-color:                           $text-primary;
      $input-border:                          $border-primary;

      $input-border-focus:                    #359325; //--now-color--focus-2
      $input-color-placeholder:               $text-tertiary;

      $form-group-margin-bottom:              $sp-space--lg;
      $label-margin-bottom:                   $sp-space--xs;
      $margin-base :                          6px;
      $legend-color:                          $text-secondary;
      $legend-border-color:                   $hr-border;

      //** Background color for textual input addons
      $input-group-addon-bg:                  $background-secondary;
      $input-group-addon-border-color:        $input-border;


      //== Dropdowns
      //
      $dropdown-bg:                           $background-primary;
      $dropdown-border:                       $hr-border;
      $dropdown-fallback-border:              $hr-border;
      $dropdown-divider-bg:                   $dropdown-border;

      $dropdown-link-color:                   $text-primary;
      $dropdown-link-hover-color:             $text-primary;
      $dropdown-link-hover-bg:                $brand-primary-opacity;

      $dropdown-link-active-color:            $component-active-color;
      $dropdown-link-active-bg:               $component-active-bg;
      $dropdown-link-disabled-color:          $text-muted;

      $dropdown-header-color:                 $text-muted;


      //== Grid system
      //
      $grid-gutter-width:                     32px;


      //== Navbar
      //
      $navbar-height:                             $sp-navbar-height;
      //=== Inverted navbar
      // Reset inverted navbar basics
      $navbar-inverse-color:                      #F0F1F5 !default; //--now-color--neutral-2
      $navbar-inverse-bg:                         #181826 !default; //--now-color_chrome--brand-10
      $navbar-inverse-border:                     #0a090f !default; //--now-color_chrome--divider-10

      // Inverted navbar links
      $navbar-inverse-link-hover-bg:              transparent !default;
      $navbar-inverse-link-active-color:          $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color !default;
      $navbar-inverse-link-active-bg:             #0a090f; //--now-color_chrome--divider-10
      $navbar-inverse-link-disabled-color:        #DADDE2; //--now-color--neutral-3
      $navbar-inverse-link-disabled-bg:           transparent;

      // Inverted navbar brand label
      $navbar-inverse-brand-color:                $navbar-inverse-link-color;
      $navbar-inverse-brand-hover-color:          $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
      $navbar-inverse-brand-hover-bg:             transparent;


      //== Navs
      //
      $nav-link-padding:                          $sp-space--sm $sp-space--lg;
      $nav-link-hover-bg:                         $background-secondary;
      $nav-disabled-link-color:                   $text-muted;
      $nav-disabled-link-hover-color:             $text-muted;

      //== Tabs
      $nav-tabs-border-color:                     $border-tertiary;
      $nav-tabs-link-hover-border-color:          transparent;
      $nav-tabs-active-link-hover-bg:             transparent;
      $nav-tabs-active-link-hover-color:          $select-primary;
      $nav-tabs-active-link-hover-border-color:   $select-primary;
      $nav-tabs-justified-link-border-color:            transparent;
      $nav-tabs-justified-active-link-border-color:     $select-primary;
      $tab-width-base :                                130px;

      //== Pills
      $nav-pills-border-radius:                   $border-radius-base !default;
      $nav-pills-active-link-hover-bg:            $select-primary;
      $nav-pills-active-link-hover-color:         $text-white;


      //== Pagination
      //
      $pagination-color:                          $link-color;
      $pagination-bg:                             $background-primary;
      $pagination-border:                    	  $hr-border;

      $pagination-hover-color:                    $link-hover-color;
      $pagination-hover-bg:                       $background-secondary;
      $pagination-hover-border:                   $border-secondary;

      $pagination-active-color:                   $text-white;
      $pagination-active-bg:                      $brand-primary;
      $pagination-active-border:                  $brand-primary;

      $pagination-disabled-color:                 $text-muted;
      $pagination-disabled-bg:                    $background-primary;
      $pagination-disabled-border:                $hr-border;


      //== Pager
      //
      $pager-border-radius:                       $sp-space--lg;

      //== Form states and alerts
      //
      $state-success-text:                        $text-primary;
      $state-success-bg:                          #C7DCB5; //--now-color_alert--positive-0
      $state-success-border:                      $brand-success;

      $state-info-text:                           $text-primary;
      $state-info-bg:                             #BDDCF1; //--now-color_alert--info-0
      $state-info-border:                         $brand-info;

      $state-warning-text:                        $text-primary;
      $state-warning-bg:                          #ECE5BF; //--now-color_alert--warning-0
      $state-warning-border:                      $brand-warning;

      $state-danger-text:                         $text-primary;
      $state-danger-bg:                           #F9C8CE; //--now-color_alert--critical-0
      $state-danger-border:                       $brand-danger;

      //== Popovers
      //
      $popover-bg:                                $background-primary;
      $popover-border-color:                      $hr-border;
      $popover-fallback-border-color:             $hr-border;
      $popover-title-bg:                          $background-secondary;


      //== Labels
      //
      $label-default-bg:                          #C2C4CA; //--now-color_alert--low-1
      $label-primary-bg:                          $brand-primary-lightest;
      $label-success-bg:                          $state-success-bg;
      $label-info-bg:                             $state-info-bg;
      $label-warning-bg:                          $state-warning-bg;
      $label-danger-bg:                           $state-danger-bg;
      $label-color:                               $text-primary;
      $label-link-hover-color:                    $text-primary;


      //== Modals
      //
      $modal-inner-padding:                       $sp-space--lg;
      $modal-title-padding:                       $sp-space--lg;
      $modal-content-bg:                          $background-primary;
      $modal-content-border-color:                $hr-border;
      $modal-content-fallback-border-color:       $hr-border;

      $modal-backdrop-bg:                         $gray-base;
      $modal-backdrop-opacity:                    .5 !default;
      $modal-header-border-color:                 $hr-border;
      $modal-footer-border-color:                 $modal-header-border-color !default;

      //== Alerts
      //

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_7e0d13aa93de76100fa17bfdfaba10be
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GeoBarkrUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GeoBarkrUtils = Class.create();
GeoBarkrUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},
    calculateDistanceBetweenPoints: function(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2) {
        // Convert degrees to radians
        function toRad(value) {
            return value * Math.PI / 180;
        }

        var R = 6371; // Radius of the Earth in km
        var dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
        var dLng = toRad(lng2 - lng1);

        var a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
            Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) *
            Math.sin(dLng / 2) * Math.sin(dLng / 2);

        var c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));

        var distanceKm = R * c; // Distance in km

        // Round
        var rounded = 0.0;
        if (distanceKm >= 10) {
            rounded = Math.round(distanceKm); // nearest integer
        } else {
            rounded = Math.round(distanceKm * 10) / 10; // round to 1 dp
        }
        return rounded.toString();
    },
    generatePlayers: function(gameID, players) {
        // Generates player records for a game with GameID for each player with a sys_id in players list

        // Check valid game
        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {
            var gamePlayers = [];

            players.forEach(function(playerID, index) {
                // Get user record
                var player = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
                if (player.get(playerID.toString())) {

                    // Initialise game player record
                    var gamePlayer = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game_player');
                    gamePlayer.initialize();

                    // Set fields
                    gamePlayer.player = player.getValue('sys_id');
                    gamePlayer.game = gameID;
                    gamePlayer.total_distance = 0;
                    gamePlayer.total_score = 0;

                    // Add sys_id to array of gamePlayer records
                    gamePlayers.push(gamePlayer.insert());
                }
            });

            // Return array of sys_ids of gameplayer records
            return gamePlayers;
        }
    },
    generateRounds: function(gameID) {
        // Generates rounds from a map for a game with ID gameID

        // Check valid game
        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {

            var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
            if (game.get(gameID)) {

                // Get locations from map
                var location = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_location');
                location.addQuery('map', game.getValue('map').toString());
                location.query();

                // Generate a round for each location in map
                while (location.next()) {
                    var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
                    round.initialize();

                    // Add info to round
                    round.game = gameID;
                    round.round_number = location.u_round_number;
                    round.location = location.sys_id;

                    // Initialise first round
                    if (location.u_round_number == '1') {
                        round.status = '2';
                        round.round_started = new GlideDateTime();
                    }

                    // Insert round
                    round.insert();
                }
                return 100;
            }
        }
    },
    getCurrentViewfromGame: function(gameID) {

        // Find current in play round
        var round = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        round.addQuery('game', gameID);
        round.addQuery('status', '2');
        round.query();

        // Get location from round
        if (round.next()) {
            var location = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_location');
            if (location.get(round.location.sys_id)) {

                return JSON.stringify({
                    lng: location.getValue('lng'),
                    lat: location.getValue('lat'),
                    heading: location.getValue('heading'),
                    pitch: location.getValue('pitch')
                });
            }
        }
        return '400';
    },
    nextRound: function(gameID) {
        // Completes current round and puts next round in play

        // Complete current round
        var currentRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        currentRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
        currentRound.addQuery('status', '2'); // In progress round
        currentRound.query();

        if (currentRound.next()) {
            currentRound.status = '3'; // Complete
            currentRound.round_ended = new GlideDateTime();
            currentRound.update();

            // Get existing round number
            var oldRoundNumber = parseInt(currentRound.getValue('round_number'));
            var newRoundNumStr = String(oldRoundNumber + 1);

            // Look for next round
            var newRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
            newRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
            newRound.addQuery('status', '1'); // Ready
            newRound.addQuery('round_number', newRoundNumStr); // Next round in map
            newRound.query();

            if (newRound.next()) {
                newRound.status = '2';
                newRound.round_started = new GlideDateTime();
                newRound.update();
                return '100';
            }

        }
        return 'test from SI';
    },
    createGuess: function(gameID, userID, distance, lat, lng) {
        // Creates guess record for given data. Calculates time spent on round.

        if (this._checkValidGame(gameID)) {
            // Get game player sys_id
            var gamePlayerID = this._getGamePlayer(gameID, userID);

            // Get current round
            var currentRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
            currentRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
            currentRound.addQuery('status', '2'); // In progress round
            currentRound.query();
            if (currentRound.next()) {

                // Initialise guess
                var guess = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_guess');
                guess.initialize();


                // Calculate time taken
                var roundStart = new GlideDateTime(currentRound.getValue('round_started').toString());
                var now = new GlideDateTime();
                var guess_time = GlideDateTime.subtract(roundStart, now);


                // Set fields
                guess.round = currentRound.getValue('sys_id');
                guess.lon = lng;
                guess.lat = lat;
                guess.player = gamePlayerID;
                guess.distance = distance;
                guess.guess_time = guess_time;

                // Insert
                return guess.insert();
            }
        }
        return '404';
    },
    checkIfNextRound: function(gameID) {
        // Checks if a game with gameID has a valid next round

        var isNextRound = 'false';

        // Get next round
        var nextRound = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_round');
        nextRound.addQuery('game', gameID);
        nextRound.addQuery('status', '1'); // A round is ready
        nextRound.query();
        if (nextRound.next()) {
            isNextRound = 'true';
        }
        return isNextRound;
    },
    getUserGameGuesses: function(gameID, userID) {
        // Returns list of JSONs of guesses for user from given game
        var guesses = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_guess');
        guesses.addQuery('round.game', gameID);
        guesses.addQuery('player.player', userID);
        guesses.orderBy('round.round_number');
        guesses.query();

        var guessList = [];
        while (guesses.next()) {
            // Get formatted time
            var timeFormatted = this._formatTimeField(guesses.getValue('guess_time'));
			var timeRaw = new GlideDateTime(guesses.getValue('guess_time')).getNumericValue()

            guessList.push({

                num: guesses.round.round_number.getValue(),
                distance: guesses.getValue('distance'),
                score: guesses.getValue('score'),
                time: timeFormatted,
                lng: guesses.getValue('lon'),
                lat: guesses.getValue('lat'),
				targetLat: guesses.round.location.lat.getValue(),
				targetLng: guesses.round.location.lng.getValue(),
				timeRaw: timeRaw/1000

            });
        }
        return JSON.stringify(guessList);
    },
    _checkValidGame: function(gameID) {
        // Checks if ID is of an active game record (status is lobby or in play)

        var game = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game');
        game.addQuery('status', 'IN', '1,2'); // Lobby or In play
        game.addQuery('sys_id', gameID);
        game.query();

        if (game.next()) {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    },
    _getGamePlayer: function(gameID, userID) {
        // Returns sys_id of gamePlayer record for gameID game and userID user
        var gamePlayer = new GlideRecord('x_1119993_geobarkr_game_player');
        gamePlayer.addQuery('player', userID);
        gamePlayer.addQuery('game', gameID);
        gamePlayer.query();

        if (gamePlayer.next()) {
            return gamePlayer.getValue('sys_id');
        }


    },
    _formatTimeField: function(timeStr) {
        // Formats time GDT into mins and secs
        var gdt = new GlideDateTime(timeStr);
        var date = new Date(gdt.getNumericValue());
        var mins = date.getUTCMinutes();

        var formattedTime = date.getUTCSeconds() + 's';
        if (mins != '0') {
            formattedTime = date.getUTCMinutes() + 'min ' + formattedTime;
        }
		return formattedTime;
    },
    type: 'GeoBarkrUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-10 23:54:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>7e0d13aa93de76100fa17bfdfaba10be</sys_id><sys_mod_count>44</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GeoBarkrUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GeoBarkr" source="x_1119993_geobarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="GeoBarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7e0d13aa93de76100fa17bfdfaba10be</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-14 18:50:01</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_header_footer"><sp_header_footer action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>standard</category><client_script><![CDATA[function pspHeaderController($rootScope, $scope, $window, spUtil, $location, $uibModal, cabrillo, $timeout, i18n, spContextManager,spAriaUtil) {
    var c = this;
	var userOptionsMessage=i18n.getMessage('User options: {userName}');
	c.userLabel = userOptionsMessage.replace('{userName}',$scope.user.name);
    $scope.avatarProfile = {
		userID: $scope.user.sys_id,
		name: $scope.user.name,
		initials: $window.NOW.user_initials
	  };
	  if ($window.NOW.user_avatar) {
		$scope.avatarProfile.userImage = $window.NOW.user_avatar;
	  }
    // Events fired from/to $rootScope for responsive mobile view.
    c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU = 'showMobileMegaMenu';
    c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP = 'showMobileMenuOnDesktop';
    c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY = 'toggleMobileMenuVisibility';

    $scope.showSearchBar = true;
    $scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
    $scope.popupType = c.data.isMobile ? 'collapse' : 'dropdown';
    $scope.expanded = false;
    $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
	var flag = 0;
    // $scope.loadingIndicator = $rootScope.loadingIndicator;

    /* Below 2 scope variables (showMobileMenuOnDesktop, showMobileMegaMenu) have counterparts in EC Navigation widget also.
     So whenever we set these variables, make sure to emit an event on rootScope to update them in the former widget as well. */

    // Determines whether to show mobile view on desktop due to oveflow of items in sub navigation bar of header.
    $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = false;
    // Used to hide global navigation tools on mobile while showing mega menu topics in right panel.
    $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;

    c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH = 767;
    $scope.mobileDevice = c.data.isMobile || ($window.innerWidth <= c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH);

    if (cabrillo.isNative())
        $scope.isViewNative = true;

    $scope.isCategorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu = false;
    $rootScope.$on('categorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu', function(event, isCategorySelected) {
        $scope.isCategorySelectedOnMobileMegaMenu = isCategorySelected;
    });
    $scope.newPageId = c.data.initialPageId;
    $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = false;
    
    c.getContainer = function(){
		  return $("." + "instance" + "-" + c.data.instanceId);
	  };

    $scope.showSearchBarMobile = function(event) {
		if (event.keyCode === 13 || event.keyCode === 32) {
			event.preventDefault();
		}
      $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = true;
      $timeout(function() {
        $scope.focusOnSearchBar();
      });
    };

   	$scope.hideSearchBarMobile = function() {
        $scope.showSearchbarOnMobile = false;
		$timeout(function(){
			 $scope.$apply();
		},10);    
    };


    document.addEventListener('focus', (event) => {
	var  currentlyFocusedElement = event.target;
	if(flag ==1)
	{
		if(currentlyFocusedElement.name!= 'search' &&  currentlyFocusedElement!=c.getContainer().find('input[name="q"]')[0] && currentlyFocusedElement!=c.getContainer().find('sn-search-combobox')[0]){
			var typeaheadSearchDiv = c.getContainer().find('#searchBox');
			typeaheadSearchDiv.removeClass("show-search").addClass('hide-search');
			$timeout(function() {
				// visibility should be hidden after the collapsing animation, hence the timeout
				typeaheadSearchDiv.addClass('visibility-collapse');
				c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon').removeClass('hidden');
			}, 500);
			if($scope.mobileDevice)
				$scope.hideSearchBarMobile();
			flag =0;
		}
	}
    }, true);

    $scope.focusOnSearchBar = function() {
		flag=1;
      // focus on the search widget input box, and add a blur event
      if (c.data.aisEnabled) {
        var searchBox = c.getContainer().find('sn-search-combobox')[0];
		if ($scope.mobileDevice)
        searchBox.addEventListener('blur', $scope.onSearchBoxBlur);
        $timeout(function() {
          searchBox.shadowRoot.childNodes[0].shadowRoot.childNodes[0].querySelector('input').focus();
        }, 500);
      } else {
        var searchBox = c.getContainer().find('input[name="q"]')[0];
		searchBox.addEventListener('keydown',(event)=>$scope.onSearchBoxTab(event));
        searchBox.focus();
      }
    };
	
		$scope.onSearchBoxTab = function(event){
			$timeout(function() {
				if(event.keyCode==9){
            var searchIcon =  c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon');
						searchIcon.focus();
				}        
        }, 525);
		
		};

    $scope.showAndExpandSearch = function(event) {
      // show typeahead search widget and hide search icon on Desktop view
			spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(i18n.getMessage("button expanded"));
      c.getContainer().find('#searchBox').removeClass('hide-search').addClass('show-search').removeClass('visibility-collapse');
	    c.getContainer().find('#searchbox-icon').addClass('hidden');
      $scope.focusOnSearchBar();
    };

    $scope.onSearchBoxBlur = function(event) {
     	$scope.hideSearchBarMobile();
    };

    $scope.getUrlParameters = function(parameter, decode, staticURL) {
      var url = staticURL ? staticURL : $location.url();
      var currLocation = (url.length) ? url : window.location.search;
      if (!currLocation || !currLocation.split("?") || currLocation.split("?").length < 2)
        return '';
      var paramArr = currLocation.split("?")[1].split("&");
      var numOfParams = paramArr.length;
      for (var i = 0; i < numOfParams; i++) {
        param = paramArr[i].split("=");
        if (param[0] === parameter)
          return (decode) ? decodeURIComponent(param[1]) : param[1];
      }
      return '';
    };

    $scope.$on("$sp.service_catalog.cart.count", function($evt, count) {
        $scope.cartItemCount = count;
    });

    $scope.$on("$locationChangeSuccess", function(event, data) {
      $scope.newPageId = $scope.getUrlParameters("id", true, data);
        if (c.data.isMobile) {
            if ($('div#popup_todos_mobile').is(":visible"))
                $('li > a#todos_popup').click();
            else if ($('div#popup_cases_mobile').is(":visible"))
                $('li > a#cases_popup').click();
        } else {
            $('li.open > a#cases_popup').click();
            $('li.open > a#todos_popup').click();
        }

      // hide modal-div on location change
      if($scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded){
        $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
        $scope.expanded = false;
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
        $rootScope.$emit(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
      }
    });

    $scope.openLogin = function() {
        $scope.modalInstance = $uibModal.open({
            templateUrl: 'spPolarisModalLogin',
            scope: $scope
        });

        var pageRoot = angular.element('.sp-page-root');
        $scope.modalInstance.rendered.then(function() {
            var $uibModalStack = $injector.get('$uibModalStack');
            var modalObj = $uibModalStack.getTop();
            var modal = modalObj.value.modalDomEl;

            modal.attr('aria-label', modal.find('.panel-title').html());
            modal.attr('aria-modal', 'true');
            pageRoot.attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
        });

        $scope.modalInstance.closed.then(function() {
            pageRoot.attr('aria-hidden', 'false');
        });
    };

    $rootScope.$on("update.searchpage", function(e, searchPage) {
        $scope.searchPage = searchPage;
    });

    $rootScope.$on('sp.avatar_changed', function() {
        $scope.userID = '';
        $timeout(function() {
            $scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
        });
    });

    $rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP, function(event, showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
        if (!showMobileMenuOnDesktop && $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
            $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
        }
        $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = showMobileMenuOnDesktop;
    });

    $rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, function(event, showMobileMegaMenu) {
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = showMobileMegaMenu;
    });

    $scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility = function(event) {
        if (event) {
            event.stopPropagation();
        }
        $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = !$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded;
        $scope.expanded = false;
        $scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
        $rootScope.$emit(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
    };

    $rootScope.$on(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY, function() {
        $scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility();
    });

    $scope.isHomepage = function() {
        if (!$scope.page.id)
            return true;

        if ($scope.page.id == $scope.portal.homepage_dv)
            return true;

        return false;
    };

}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$sp-space--xxs: 2px !default;
$sp-space--xs: 4px !default;
$sp-space--sm: 8px !default;
$sp-space--md: 12px !default;
$sp-space--lg: 16px !default;
$sp-space--xl: 24px !default;
$sp-space--3xl: 40px !default;
$background-primary : $body-bg !default;
$font-size-md: 16px !default;
$font-size-large: 20px !default;
$font-size-xl: 24px !default;
$brand-primary-darker: darken($brand-primary,16) !default;

#searchBox .btn{
  padding : 0px $sp-space--lg;
}

.dropdown-menu.empty-dropdown.ng-scope,.dropdown-menu.cart-dropdown.custom-drop-down,.dropdown-menu.wishlist-menu.custom-drop-down {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  padding-bottom: 0 !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}


.navbar-inverse {
  margin-bottom: 0px;
  border-radius: 0px; 
  background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
  .navbar-header {
    &.nav-container {
      width: 100%;

      .sub-navbar-overflow-entry-button {
        position: relative;
        float: right;
        margin: $sp-space--md $sp-space--lg $sp-space--md 0;
        padding: $sp-space--sm $sp-space--sm;
        background-color: transparent;
        background-image: none;
        border: .1rem solid transparent;
        border-radius: $border-radius-base;
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .25);

       .label {
         float: right;
         margin-right: -$sp-space--xs;
         margin-top: -$sp-space--sm;
         padding: $sp-space--xxs $sp-space--xs;
       }

       .label-as-badge {
          font-size: $font-size-xs;
          position: relative;
          top: -$sp-space--xxs;
          left: $sp-space--xxs;
          padding: $sp-space--xxs $sp-space--xs;
          margin-left: 0;
          background-color: $btn-danger-bg;
          color: $background-primary;
        }

        .icon-bar {
          display: block;
          width: 2.2rem;
          height: .2rem;
          border-radius: $border-radius-small;
          background-color: $background-primary;
        }
        .icon-bar + .icon-bar {
          margin-top: $sp-space--xs;
        }
      }
    }

    .mobile-view-on-desktop {
    	position: absolute;
      z-index: 999;
      /* 60px is height of the header strip */
      top: 60px;
      right: 0;
      min-height: 500px;
      max-width: 400px;
      background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 5px $navbar-inverse-link-color;
      color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;

      .mobile-view-navbar {
         list-style: none;
         padding: 0 $sp-space--sm;
         margin: 0;
         display: flex;
         flex-direction: column;
         border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 45%);

         .main-header-items {
           list-style: none;
           padding: $sp-space--md 0 0 $sp-space--lg;
           margin: 0;
           display: flex;
           flex-direction: column;

           & > li {
             &:not(:last-child) {
               padding-top: $sp-space--lg;
             }
             // Cart, tours, and Wishlist (Mobile View)
             .nav.navbar-nav {
               display: flex;
               flex-direction: column;

               li {
                 padding-top: $sp-space--lg;
               }
             }
           }
         }

         .mobile-mega-menu-entry {
           margin: 0 -$sp-space--sm;
           padding: $sp-space--xl $sp-space--lg;
           background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
           
           .dropdown-menu {
           	background-color: transparent;
           }
         }
         .separator {
           margin: 20px -$sp-space--sm;
           border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 30%);
         }

         li > a {
           color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;
           padding: 0;

           &:hover, &:focus {
             color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color !important;
             background-color: transparent;
           }
           &:focus {
             box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
             padding: $sp-space--xs;
             border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
             border-radius: $border-radius-base;
           }
         }
        .header-menu-item > a{
        	padding: $sp-space--md $sp-space--sm;
        }
       }

      .impersonate-and-logout {
          div > ul > li:first-child {
            height: 0;

            ul.dropdown-menu {
              width: 400px;
              display: block;
              z-index: inherit;
              background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
              box-shadow: none;
              border-radius: 0;
              padding-left: $sp-space--xxs;
              padding-bottom: $sp-space--lg;

              li > a {
                line-height: 2;

                &:hover, &:focus {
                  color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color !important;
                  background-color: transparent;
                }
                &:focus {
                  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
                  padding: $sp-space--xs;
                  margin-left: $sp-space--lg;
                  border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
                  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
                  width: fit-content;
                }
              }
              li:first-child {
                display: none;
              }
           }
         }
       }
     }

    .navbar-brand {
      margin: 0;
      height: 65px;
      padding: $sp-logo-margin-y 0px $sp-space--sm $sp-space--lg;
      img, span {
        margin: 0;
        margin-top: 5px;
        margin-left: 30px;
        display: block;
        max-height: 50px;
        position: relative;
        top: 50%;
        -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%);
        -ms-transform: translateY(-50%);
        transform: translateY(-50%);
	padding-right: $sp-space--sm;
      }
    }

    .navbar-right .dropdown-menu > li > a {
      &:hover, &:focus {
        background-color: darken($navbar-inverse-bg, 8%);
      }

      &:focus {
        border: 0.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
        border-radius: $border-radius-base;
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
      }
    }
  }
  .dropdown-menu > li > a {
    color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;
  }
  .dropdown-toggle:focus {
  	outline: thin dotted;
    outline: 5px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color;
  }
  .sub-navbar {
    background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
    border: none;
    width: 100%;
   
    #cart-dropdown, #wishlist-menu {
      display: none;
      ~ * {
        display: none !important;
      }
    }
    .navbar-nav > li > a[href="?id=sc_cart"], .navbar-nav > li > a[href="?id=sc_wishlist"] {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .gtd-dropdown-container {
      display: none;
    }
    .open > a, .open > a:focus {
      background-color: darken($sp-navbar-divider-color, 8%);
    }
    #cart-dropdown {
      display: none;
      :after {
        content: "\f0d7";
        vertical-align: baseline;
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        border: none;
        margin-left: sp-space--xs !important;
        display: inline-block;
        font: normal normal normal $font-size-small/1 FontAwesome;
        font-size: inherit;
        text-rendering: auto;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      }
    }
   
    .dropdown-menu {
      background-color: $sp-navbar-divider-color;
      > li > a:hover, > li > a:focus {
        background-color: darken($sp-navbar-divider-color, 8%);
	box-shadow:unset;
      }
    }
  }
  .dropdown-menu {
    background-color: rgba($navbar-inverse-bg, 0.97);
    border: none;
    &.case-menu {
      right: 0;
      left: auto;
      padding: 0;
      width: 450px;
      background: $background-primary;
      overflow-y: hidden;
    }
  }
  > .open > a:hover, > .open > a:focus  {
    background-color: darken($navbar-invese-bg, 8%);
  }
  .fa-caret-down {
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin-top: $sp-space--xxs;
  }
  .caret:before {
    content: "\f0d7";
  }
  .caret {
    vertical-align: baseline;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    border: none;
    margin-left: $sp-space--xs !important;
    display: inline-block;
    font: normal normal normal $font-size-small/1 FontAwesome;
    font-size: inherit;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  }
  .label-as-badge {
    font-size: $font-size-xs;
    position: relative;
    top: -$sp-space--sm;
    left: -$sp-space--xxs;
    padding: -$sp-space--xxs $sp-space--xs;
    margin-left: 0;
    background-color: $btn-danger-bg;
    color: $background-primary;
  }
  .navbar {
    transition: 250ms opacity ease-in-out; 
    -webkit-transition: 250ms opacity ease-in-out; 
    border: 0;
  }
  .navbar-fade {
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  .navbar-collapse {
    padding-right: 0px;
  }
  .case-menu {
    div#widget-tabs-2 {
      border: none;
      > .panel-heading {
        border: none;
        border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
      }
    }
  }

  ul.nav.navbar-nav {
    // Hiding the loading indicator from Header Menu base system widget
    div.header-loader {
       display: none;
    }
    li.sp-loading-indicator {
       padding-top: $sp-space--xl;
       margin-top: $sp-space--xxs;
    }
  }
  
  #more-items-dropdown {
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .cart-dropdown, .wishlist-menu, .gtd-dropdown-container .empty-dropdown {
    width: 350px;
    padding: 0;
    z-index: 1000;
    border-top-left-radius: $border-radius-base !important;
    border-top-right-radius: $border-radius-base !important;

    ul {
      max-height: 300px;
      overflow: auto;
    }

            // collapse mobile nav if clicked an anchor that isn't a dropdown toggle
            scope.expanded = false;

    // Helper function to handle the arrow key navigation in the header
    function handleKeyPressEvents(e) {
        var target = e.target;
        var querySelector;
        if ($(this).hasClass('main-header-item'))
            querySelector = 'li.main-header-item';
        else if ($(this).hasClass('gt-menu-item'))
            querySelector = 'li.gt-menu-item';

        if (target.localName === 'a') {
            var currentMenuItem = $(target).parents('li');
            var parentUL = currentMenuItem.parents('ul');
            var allMenuItems = parentUL.children(querySelector);

            if (querySelector === 'li.gt-menu-item' && !(e.keyCode === 37 || e.keyCode === 39 || e.keyCode === 9))

            else if (querySelector === 'li.main-header-item' && !(e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40))

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_ae5d1b6293de76100fa17bfdfaba1053
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1119993_geobarkr.geoBarkrAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>geoBarkrAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var geoBarkrAjax = Class.create();
geoBarkrAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    getDistanceFromLongLats: function() {
		// Get params
		var longlat1 = JSON.parse(this.getParameter('sysparm_longlat1'));
		var longlat2 = JSON.parse(this.getParameter('sysparm_longlat2'));

		// Get calculation and return
		var calc = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return calc.calculateDistanceBetweenPoints(longlat1.lng, longlat1.lat, longlat2.lng, longlat2.lat);
    },
	getViewDetailsFromGame: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Get location details and return
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.getCurrentViewfromGame(gameID);
	},
	nextRound: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Get location details and return
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.nextRound(gameID);
	},
	createGuess: function() {
		var distance = this.getParameter('sysparm_distance');
		var lat = this.getParameter('sysparm_lat');
		var lng = this.getParameter('sysparm_lng');
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');
		var userID = gs.getUserID();

		// Create guess record with calculations
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.createGuess(gameID, userID, distance, lat, lng);
	},
	checkIfNextRound: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');

		// Check if next round available in this game
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.checkIfNextRound(gameID);
	},
	getUserGameGuesses: function() {
		var gameID = this.getParameter('sysparm_gameID');
		var userID = gs.getUserID();

		// Get guess details for user from utils
		var utils = new x_1119993_geobarkr.GeoBarkrUtils();
		return utils.getUserGameGuesses(gameID, userID);
	},
    type: 'geoBarkrAjax'
});

]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-10 23:58:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>ae5d1b6293de76100fa17bfdfaba1053</sys_id><sys_mod_count>43</sys_mod_count><sys_name>geoBarkrAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GeoBarkr" source="x_1119993_geobarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="GeoBarkr">a4e2616e93de36100fa17bfdfaba1042</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_ae5d1b6293de76100fa17bfdfaba1053</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-14 17:36:02</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
